operations.description: Compare a measure across time to identify trajectory, velocity, and pattern changes.

execution.logic: Aggregate the measure into ordered time intervals and calculate changes between observations.

preconditions: A valid time dimension and aggregation are defined.
limitations: Account for incomplete periods, missing intervals, and seasonality.

operations.description: Compare the current period with a previous period, including MoM, QoQ, YoY, or custom date ranges.

execution.logic: Calculate the measure for both periods and return absolute and percentage differences.

preconditions: Period boundaries and comparison rules are explicit.
limitations: Handle zero denominators and unequal period coverage.

operations.description: Break a measure down by a valid dimension to evaluate categorical splits.

execution.logic: Group records by dimension members and calculate the selected measure.

preconditions: The dimension has a valid relationship to the measure.
limitations: Validate join grain and avoid duplicated aggregation.

operations.description: Break a measure into its registered components or additive sub-metrics.

execution.logic: Resolve the registered decomposition definition and calculate its component measures.

preconditions: The measure has an explicit, valid decomposition.
limitations: Components must reconcile with the total under the registered formula.

operations.description: Identify dimensions or entities contributing most to a measure change or total volume.

execution.logic: Calculate group values, shares of the overall total, and contributions to change when comparison periods are provided.

preconditions: The denominator or comparison baseline is meaningful.
limitations: Distinguish contribution to a total from contribution to a change.

operations.description: Analyze the distribution and spread of a measure across dimension members or numeric value bins.

execution.logic: Calculate frequencies, quantiles, spread, and distribution statistics at the declared observation grain.

preconditions: The numeric measure and analysis grain are defined.
limitations: Aggregated group values and record-level values represent different distributions.

operations.description: Analyze registered reason codes or explanatory categorical dimensions to understand business outcomes.

execution.logic: Group outcome counts or rates by reason category and rank the categories.

preconditions: Reason values have defined meanings and are associated with the target outcome.
limitations: Recorded reasons may be incomplete or subjective and do not automatically establish root cause.

operations.description: Determine whether changes in dimensional composition or volume mix contributed to an aggregate measure change.

execution.logic: Separate changes associated with group proportions from changes in group-level values using a documented decomposition method.

preconditions: Groups are consistently defined across periods and the metric supports the selected decomposition.
limitations: Decomposition results depend on the chosen method and treatment of interaction effects.

operations.description: Identify dimension members with unusually high or low values relative to an appropriate cohort baseline.

execution.logic: Calculate a suitable baseline and flag group values that meet the selected outlier criterion.

preconditions: A meaningful comparison population and sufficient observations exist.
limitations: Unusual values are not necessarily errors or failures.

operations.description: Order entities from highest to lowest to isolate top performers and underperforming laggards.

execution.logic: Aggregate by dimension, order by the selected measure, and assign ranks.

preconditions: The ranking measure, direction, and aggregation are defined.
limitations: Use rates or normalized metrics where raw totals are not comparable.

operations.description: Identify the smallest set of dimension members accounting for a selected share of a total.

execution.logic: Rank groups by contribution and calculate cumulative contribution percentages.

preconditions: Group contributions can be meaningfully compared against the total.
limitations: The 80/20 relationship is a hypothesis to test, not a guaranteed distribution.

operations.description: Measure dependency on a small number of accounts, suppliers, destinations, or other entities.

execution.logic: Calculate top-N shares and, where appropriate, a concentration index from entity-level contributions.

preconditions: The entity population and concentration measure are defined.
limitations: Concentration is an exposure indicator, not proof that a loss will occur.

operations.description: Compare actual performance against targets, SLAs, budgets, peer groups, or baselines.

execution.logic: Align actual and benchmark values and calculate absolute and relative deviations.

preconditions: A valid benchmark source, scope, and comparison rule exist.
limitations: Ensure benchmarks are comparable in time period, units, and population.

operations.description: Show sequential positive and negative changes bridging an initial state to a final total or target.

execution.logic: Calculate change components and order them to reconcile the initial value to the final value.

preconditions: The change components reconcile under a defined decomposition.
limitations: Do not label unexplained residuals as known drivers.

operations.description: Quantify shortfalls or surpluses between actual performance and defined goals or expectations.

execution.logic: Calculate actual minus target and classify the gap according to the business objective.

preconditions: The target and direction of desirable performance are defined.
limitations: A positive gap is not always favorable; interpretation depends on the measure.

operations.description: Calculate running totals, cumulative progress, YTD, or MTD accumulations.

execution.logic: Aggregate in time order and calculate the running value within the specified partition and reset boundary.

preconditions: Time ordering, window boundaries, and reset rules are defined.
limitations: Use only for measures with appropriate cumulative semantics.

operations.description: Compare lifecycle behavior and performance among groups sharing a defined inception event.

execution.logic: Assign entities to cohorts and compare their metrics across consistent elapsed-time windows.

preconditions: Cohort membership and observation windows are defined.
limitations: Incomplete follow-up can bias comparisons.

operations.description: Analyze stage-by-stage conversion, velocity, and drop-off across sequential workflows.

execution.logic: Determine eligible entities at each stage and calculate stage counts, transition rates, drop-offs, and elapsed times where available.

preconditions: Stage mappings, transition rules, and entity identifiers are defined.
limitations: Handle alternative paths, skipped stages, and incomplete records.

operations.description: Measure attrition, repeat activity, and retention across defined time windows.

execution.logic: Identify active entities and repeat activity within defined windows, applying an explicit churn rule.

preconditions: Entity activity history and churn definitions are available.
limitations: Do not apply customer-retention concepts to entities without a meaningful repeat-activity lifecycle.

operations.description: Evaluate statistical association between two or more continuous measures.

execution.logic: Calculate suitable association statistics at a compatible observation grain.

preconditions: Measures have compatible observations and a defined statistical method.
limitations: Correlation does not prove causation.

operations.description: Measure the responsiveness of an outcome relative to changes in an input driver.

execution.logic: Estimate a suitable elasticity or sensitivity measure using a defined model or controlled scenario.

preconditions: The input-output relationship and calculation method are defined.
limitations: Observed responsiveness is not necessarily causal; percentage changes require suitable nonzero baselines.

operations.description: Compute normalized unit economics, efficiency ratios, margins, and rates.

execution.logic: Calculate the registered ratio or rate using compatible populations, units, and aggregation grains.

preconditions: The ratio formula and denominator eligibility rules are defined.
limitations: Handle zero denominators and avoid averaging group-level ratios without appropriate weighting.

operations.description: Compare actual utilization or throughput with a defined capacity limit.

execution.logic: Calculate utilization rates and remaining capacity from compatible actual and capacity measures.

preconditions: Capacity data and measurement units are available.
limitations: Do not infer theoretical capacity from actual activity alone.

operations.description: Analyze intersections of two categorical dimensions across a shared measure.

execution.logic: Group by both dimensions and calculate counts or the selected measure.

preconditions: Both dimensions have valid relationships to the same analysis grain.
limitations: Sparse cells and high cardinality can make comparisons unreliable.

operations.description: Identify recurring patterns across calendar cycles.

execution.logic: Aggregate by the relevant calendar position and evaluate repeated patterns across cycles.

preconditions: Sufficient historical coverage exists for the selected cycle.
limitations: Distinguish seasonal patterns from trends and changes in data coverage.

operations.description: Measure the rate of change and acceleration of a metric over time.

execution.logic: Calculate successive changes per unit time and changes in those rates.

preconditions: Ordered observations with meaningful time intervals are available.
limitations: Results can be sensitive to interval size, noise, and missing observations.

operations.description: Group entities by how recently and how frequently defined activities occur.

execution.logic: Calculate time since the most recent activity and activity frequency within the defined window.

preconditions: Activity history and a reference date are defined.
limitations: Choose windows appropriate to the business activity; recency does not necessarily imply future behavior.

operations.description: Classify entities into quartiles, deciles, or custom tiers based on their relative metric values.

execution.logic: Calculate percentile ranks or quantile boundaries and assign entities to the requested tiers.

preconditions: A defined entity grain and sufficient observations exist.
limitations: Ties, small populations, and changing comparison populations can affect tier membership.

operations.description: Identify measures or entities that breach configured thresholds, SLAs, or control limits.

execution.logic: Evaluate the metric against registered threshold rules and classify the result.

preconditions: Thresholds, directions, and evaluation scopes are defined.
limitations: Distinguish business thresholds from statistically derived control limits.

operations.description: Identify unexpected spikes, drops, or patterns relative to an appropriate baseline.

execution.logic: Compare observed values with expected values from a suitable baseline or anomaly model.

preconditions: Sufficient observations and an appropriate baseline are available.
limitations: Anomalies require investigation and are not automatically errors or business failures.

operations.description: Traverse valid dimensional hierarchies to investigate drivers of a high-level metric or variance.

execution.logic: Rank relevant groups at each hierarchy level, select meaningful branches, and continue until the stopping criteria are met.

preconditions: Hierarchy levels, valid relationships, and a drill-down stopping rule are defined.
limitations: A drill-down identifies localized patterns but does not prove causation.

operations.description: Find items or events that frequently co-occur within the same transaction or defined unit.

execution.logic: Calculate co-occurrence counts and association-rule statistics within the defined observation unit.

preconditions: A meaningful transaction or co-occurrence unit and repeated item or event data exist.
limitations: Co-occurrence does not imply causation. This operation is unsuitable without repeated item-level observations.

operations.description: Categorize open items by elapsed time since creation or entry into a defined state.

execution.logic: Calculate elapsed age for eligible open items and aggregate counts or amounts into defined buckets.

preconditions: Open status, start date, reference date, and bucket boundaries are defined.
limitations: Use business-specific aging rules and exclude closed items where appropriate.

operations.description: Estimate future period totals using current pace, recent run rates, and historical patterns.

execution.logic: Estimate a run-rate projection or apply a validated forecasting method appropriate to the data.

preconditions: The projection basis, elapsed period, remaining period, and forecast assumptions are defined.
limitations: A simple run rate assumes a pace that may not persist; label projections and model-based forecasts distinctly.

operations.description: Model how a target metric changes under hypothetical input values or operational scenarios.

execution.logic: Recalculate the target metric for each scenario using registered formulas, assumptions, and constraints.

preconditions: The relationship between scenario inputs and target metric is explicitly defined.
limitations: Hypothetical outputs are conditional calculations, not guaranteed predictions or causal effects.
